{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:02.019
    | text      = The extreme right wing that Tucker represents has decided that they've done enough demonization
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:04.940
    | text      = around trans people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:06.059
    | text      = And now it's time to fully commit to attacking homosexuality as a valid part of society.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:10.840
    | text      = They want to undo that progress and are setting their sights on that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:15.639
    | text      = Yeah, that's about how poems work.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:17.600
    | text      = For anyone who hasn't followed his history, Milo Yiannopoulos was a blogger working for
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:21.399
    | text      = Breitbart who rose to huge levels of popularity in the era around the 2016 election.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:26.759
    | text      = He positioned himself as a gay man who supported the extreme right, which is his entire brand.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:31.899
    | text      = He was a troll and he talked all kinds of shit on LGBTQ folks in the same way that pretty
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:36.340
    | text      = much everyone in his world did at the time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:38.940
    | text      = But he was a gay man, which gave him access to a different kind of trolling.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:43.059
    | text      = It created a very lucrative place for him to exist in that market.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:46.940
    | text      = He was different than the other guys around his political space because he was fun.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:51.279
    | text      = He was a sassy dude who did a ton of cocaine and he had a sense of humor.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:55.580
    | text      = He really wasn't all that funny, but he had the speech patterns that sound like someone
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:59.419
    | text      = who's saying something funny.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:00.899
    | text      = And every now and then he landed a pithy line.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:04.019
    | text      = Because he was different from the stuffy right wingers you'd find in his media, he was afforded
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:08.139
    | text      = a lot of opportunities that his peers didn't get, like being a regular guest on Joe Rogan's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:12.700
    | text      = podcast and other shows that presented themselves as non-political at the time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:17.679
    | text      = Milo was one of the first large accounts who were kicked off Twitter, and it led to him
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:21.399
    | text      = finding an important role in the pretend free speech activism that was popular around that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:26.220
    | text      = time.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:27.220
    | text      = He would plan speeches at college campuses and then monetize the outrage that was created
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:31.179
    | text      = by the student body not wanting him to be there, and it was a cycle.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:36.580
    | text      = Among his contemporaries, I find Milo a bit more fascinating because beyond his need to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:41.580
    | text      = incite outrage, there's not really much to him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:45.320
    | text      = There isn't much to him past this troll shit and if they just ignored him his act wouldn't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:50.100
    | text      = work and there would be no money for him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:53.299
    | text      = And I do suspect that Milo's always known that, which is why he had to be more sensational
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:57.899
    | text      = than his peers.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:59.379
    | text      = He had to do things that would guarantee backlash, because as people started to catch on that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:03.899
    | text      = he was just trying to elicit a response from them to get paid, it would become harder to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:07.940
    | text      = create that response.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:10.120
    | text      = By being even more extreme than the people around him, Milo was trying to make sure that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:14.299
    | text      = what he did caused outrage, even among the people who might ignore some of the other
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:18.779
    | text      = guys in that media space.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:21.460
    | text      = And being a gay man helped him out considerably in that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:24.580
    | text      = He was able to say flagrantly homophobic things that his heterosexual peers would probably
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:28.740
    | text      = have a tough time pulling off and because he was gay he never really needed sources.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:34.379
    | text      = He could say something sensational about gay people and if he needed to back up where he
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:38.379
    | text      = was getting this from he could always just appeal to his own authority as someone who
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:42.500
    | text      = was gay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:43.500
    | text      = I'm gay, I know this stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:45.899
    | text      = He was doing really well in late 2016 when he was poised to release his autobiography
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:50.860
    | text      = Dangerous along with a bus tour of public incitement events to promote it called the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:56.059
    | text      = Dangerous F Tour.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:58.500
    | text      = What a huge mistake that was.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:00.120
    | text      = In the lead up to the book's publishing, some videos of Milo's podcast appearances went
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:04.019
    | text      = around social media and kind of destroyed his career.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:07.139
    | text      = They featured him discussing gay relationships and included him arguing that relationships
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:11.379
    | text      = between older men and 13 year old boys were totally fine if the 13 year old is emotionally
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:15.980
    | text      = mature which many people interpreted as him condoning pedophilia.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:19.779
    | text      = Yeah, well that's what it would be.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:22.159
    | text      = Later Milo would go on to explain that a lot of this stuff was based on him trying to rationalize
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:26.080
    | text      = his own past as a survivor of child abuse and that he was raped by a priest at age 13.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:31.879
    | text      = At the time he did these podcast interviews he didn't view that interaction as abuse and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:36.100
    | text      = thought of himself as the instigator of the sexual relationship and that perspective informed
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:40.799
    | text      = what he was saying in those interviews.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:44.039
    | text      = I think it's important to let people who have experienced trauma understand that trauma
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:47.720
    | text      = how they feel is appropriate.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:49.720
    | text      = It's not for me to demand that you take on my definitions of the things that you experienced
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:53.519
    | text      = in your life so I think that if Milo had just said in these interviews that he had
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:57.399
    | text      = sex with an adult man as a 13 year old and didn't consider it to be abuse there wouldn't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:02.320
    | text      = have been a problem.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:04.059
    | text      = It would have been one person discussing their perspective which you're welcome to agree
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:07.419
    | text      = or disagree with but if he expressed himself like that then it wouldn't have been heard
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:11.559
    | text      = as something that he felt should be universalized.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:16.159
    | text      = He wasn't just speaking about his own experience though.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:19.080
    | text      = Instead he was making prescriptive statements that minimized the impact of adults having
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:22.799
    | text      = sex with children and that basically destroyed his career forever.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:27.639
    | text      = Almost immediately his publisher dropped him in his autobiography and he had to resign
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
